data.other_hard: completed first degree (Bachelor's or equivalent) required; age cap 28 for Master's-level study; age cap 30 for PhD
data.evidence_sentence: The main requirements are strict gates rather than guidelines: A completed first degree (Bachelor's or equivalent) is required; MAECI applies age caps: 28 for Master's-level study, 30 for PhD; The annual call lists the eligible countries — check the Study in Italy portal.
data.notes: Page describes Italian government grants for international students in Master's, PhD, AFAM arts programmes and research projects; AFAM arts programmes and research projects not mapped to degree levels beyond master and phd. Eligible countries are not listed on the page; the annual call lists them (nationality_rule set to INTERNATIONAL based on the 'international students' wording, which may be incomplete). Funding: €900 monthly allowance (stipend) plus tuition/enrolment fee exemption at most institutions (tuition); full funding not stated, so partial is listed as the page describes the award as having gaps. Deadline 2027-06-01 is for the 2027–28 call; page says 'typically due May–June 2027'. Page text repeats sections; 'last verified 2 July 2026'. Award is offered by Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Page lacks a clear field of study statement.
